content:
Amir: Heads-up — between 04:12-04:20 UTC a small percentage of onboarding uploads failed to finish. Collecting affected tenants now. Liz, can CS prep comms for trials + any accounts in renewal windows?

Rory (SRE): Confirmed. Root cause was a transient write-timeout to our embedding writer after a config flip; retries are in flight and queue drain looks healthy. Not a model change.

ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-121. Retry-job started.

Liz (CS): Thanks. Please avoid technical detail in external notes. For renewals offer an elevated remediation: 1 month of premium support or a stronger credit. For trials offer a 60-min recovery session + 5% credit.

Bea (AE): RetailEdge-9 is in renewal window — mark high-touch. I want the premium-support offer and a 30-min technical sync with SREs. I'll join outreach.

Amir: Affected list (preview): StarterTrial-19, RetailEdge-9, UniClass-4. I'll send the full list in 10m.

Liz (CS): Draft external (short): "Hi <Name>, we experienced brief delays processing uploads between 04:12-04:20 UTC that may have affected some items. We've retried pending uploads and prioritized impacted accounts. We're sorry for the inconvenience — we'd like to offer a complimentary 60-minute recovery session and a one-time 5% credit. If you still see missing items reply and we'll prioritize manual re-ingest."

Liz (CS): High-touch RetailEdge-9 draft: "Hi <Name>, apologies — we've prioritized your uploads and added a named SRE contact to help. To make this right we'd like to offer one month of premium support or a 30% invoice credit, plus a 30-minute technical sync. Please let us know which you prefer."

Rory (SRE): Queue is draining. I'll provide a simple internal root-cause note: config propagation caused a transient write-timeout; we'll add a guard so write-timeout flips require canary verification.

Amir: Plan: 1) Send high-touch to renewal accounts now. 2) Broadcast standard note to trials in 15m once queue is fully drained. 3) Open office-hours and capture feedback for RCA. Bea/Liz coordinate on the RetailEdge note and billing tag: "incident-credit-1867004321".

Bea (AE): Will DM the concession wording and take RetailEdge-9 live thread.

Liz (CS): Sending high-touch now. Will log responses in the CS tracker and add notes to the RCA. Update execs by EOD. :thumbsup:
